nodes.label: Logo Universidad del Cauca (horizontal, variant B — white/light version)
nodes.description: Official horizontal logo of Universidad del Cauca in its 'B' (white/inverted) variant. The logo renders white-on-transparent, making it suitable for use on dark or coloured backgrounds. It is stored as a static branding asset in the Angular frontend application (DeporteParaTodos) under src/assets/imagesSystem/.
nodes.purpose: Institutional branding asset — university identity mark used in the application UI (likely in header, login screen, or footer).
